items.title: The Results Are In: Voters Hate Data Centers
items.excerpt: From high-profile Senate races to local rezoning initiatives, data centers and their supporters did miserably on the ballot in the 2026 midterms.

items.excerpt: Voters approved dozens of data center moratoriums; per Ballotpedia about two dozen of 41 restrict/block measures across 10 states appeared to pass, and Texas governor-elect Hinojosa campaigned on keeping a data center construction moratorium until the legislature acts.

items.title: Texas was the new epicenter of the AI data center buildout. That might be kaput.

items.title: Musk’s Minnesota Deepfake Fight Could Define AI’s First Amendment
